read.en: Coherent rose 9.2% on Nov 11 to $234.51, trading $223.67–245.73. It is above the 5-day ($207.4) and 10-day ($208.7) and below the 30-day ($250.2), 100-day ($290.7) and 200-day ($296.8); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($162.97), and RSI is 49.8.
read.zh: Coherent 11月11日上涨 9.2%，收于 $234.51，盘中区间 $223.67–245.73。股价位于 5 日（$207.4）和 10 日均线（$208.7）上方，30 日（$250.2）、100 日（$290.7）和 200 日均线（$296.8）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$162.97），RSI 为 49.8。

read.en: The rally reclaimed the $220.7 Jul 29 low and cleared the $227.8–229.5 Nov 9–10 highs, now support; the $245.73 high faded back under the $235.8–239.6 Oct 27–29 closes. Resistance is $235.8–239.6, then $245.7–246.9 (Nov 11 and Oct 29 highs) and $250.2 (30-day). Support is $223.7–229.5, then $220.7 and $207–209 (5 and 10-day). A close above $239.6 would target $246–250; below $223.7, $220.7.

s.en: Nov 11 low $223.67; Nov 10 high $227.77; Nov 9 high $229.48
